review_role: Independent AI-assisted internal scientific/source review; not qualified external biological review
source_checks: Independently parsed both full article XML representations and verified DOI, versioned PMCID and explicit CC BY 4.0 article terms.
Recomputed all 18 source-text anchor hashes from the 2022 XML and checked each original interpretation against its source section.
Verified the decoded Figure 7 script against API content, Git blob framing and membership in the nontruncated 62-entry repository tree. No source-author code was executed.

Checked static ancestor exclusion, positive-estimate filtering, positional barcode attachment, population alias, unmatched-label classification and trajectory filtering without claiming an observed input error.
Checked cached S4 metadata and the 2018 supplement listing while retaining unacquired workbook contents and unresolved 29-versus-28 clone membership.

Verified twelve acquisition attempts, including the two reviewer pre-HTTP failures, and all 24 retained source-related file hashes totaling 807863 bytes. Root cross-reviewed the reviewer failure receipts.
scientific_findings: Experimental fitness checks do not establish empirical validation of the inferred formation rate; the source explicitly calls for its experimental confirmation.
The eleven reporter trajectories and follow-up assay material share the prior 2018 evolution populations. Additional assays do not imply a newly evolved independent cohort.
Generation-window adaptation, synthetic holdout checks, inferred establishment times and simulator mismatch are accurately separated from frozen native TMD evaluation.
Positive coefficients are distinguished from statistical significance and complete clone or mutation-event denominators.
No native panel, biological fit, independent mutation-birth observer, source numerical replay or complete supply/establishment measurement is admitted.
rights_and_privacy: Original analysis only. Article CC BY 4.0 is authenticated; separate OSF terms and the GitHub license body remain unverified. Raw article/code captures, contacts and private filesystem locators are excluded.
protected_state_scope: This source review admits no changes to 26 study NULLs, 18 planning NULLs, R5/R11/R17, theta/eta, comparators, evaluation, error allocation, stopping, paused runner or methods 0.6.0. Exact integration preservation is reviewed separately.
scope: Acceptance binds these seven payloads. Integrated files, immutable commit, website and delivery require separate review.
